title: 3 free tools that do the boring part of editing
intro: Cut silences, trim clips without losing quality, and post everywhere from one place. All three are free and open source.
reel: From the reel: Stop editing every video by hand

tools.name: Auto-Editor
tools.what: Cuts out the silent parts of a video by itself, based on loudness. It can also hand the cut to Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro, so you keep editing there.

copy.label: Send the cut to Premiere Pro (use resolve or final-cut-pro for the others)

tools.name: LosslessCut
tools.what: Trim, cut and join video and audio without re-saving the whole file, so there is no quality loss and it is fast.

tools.name: Postiz
tools.what: Schedule one post to Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Threads and more from one place. Free if you run it yourself; there is also a paid cloud version.

sections.heading: Start here
steps: Install Auto-Editor (instructions at auto-editor.com/installing) and run it on one talking video.
Open the result in your editor and check the cuts before you trust it.
Use LosslessCut for quick trims and joins you don't need a full editor for.
Try Postiz with one platform first, then add the rest.

note: The tools do the cutting. You make the video worth watching.
